survey: A cartoon refractor telescope stands on cratered lunar ground under a striped teal sky. The camera is a little above the scene: the ground, the craters (wide, flat ellipses), the round wooden tripod head and the grey base plate are all seen from slightly above, so they agree. The cream tube rises diagonally from the eyepiece at lower left to a wider dew shield at upper right. It runs through a grey fork mount bolted to the base plate on the tripod head, and the tube looks like one continuous straight line through the fork. The front lens faces the viewer and to the right, and the eyepiece end faces away to the left. There are three wooden legs. The front-left leg is nearest the viewer, one leg is behind and one splays back to the right. Each ends in a grey foot cap that sits on the ground, with a shadow cast back and to the right. This matches the ground plane and how the feet sit on it at different depths.

errors.where: Front lens / dew-shield rim at the upper right of the tube
errors.what: The lens opening is drawn as a fairly open, nearly upright ellipse, as if the tube pointed almost straight at the viewer. But the tube is shown nearly side-on along its full length, and the narrow rings at the eyepiece end and the gold band agree with that. The rim ellipse should be narrower, with its long axis at a right angle to the tube's diagonal.

fix: Draw the front lens rim of the telescope as a narrower ellipse that matches the tube's mostly side-on view, with its long axis at a right angle to the tube's diagonal, so that it matches the ellipses at the eyepiece end.
